latest.headline: E69Korrea Claims Breakthrough Maiden Victory in Greece
latest.paragraph: E69Korrea secured his first win of the season at the Greece rally, finishing with a total time of 52 minutes 31.163 seconds. He showcased impressive consistency, claiming two stage wins and accumulating 39 total points. SubaruNyx finished in second place, trailing by 17.672 seconds, while Flinnowaty rounded out the podium. The event proved challenging for the field, as twelve drivers recorded at least one DNF. Despite the high attrition rate, E69Korrea maintained his pace throughout the six stages to climb the standings and solidify his position in the championship.
